class.name: SteamSharedCloudFileOperation
class.brief_description: Retained observation of one shared Steam Cloud download.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Ends local observation and completes it with [constant ERR_SKIP]. Steam finishes the native download and closes any resulting cache entry. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when observation has already ended.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Returns whether the operation has a terminal result.

method.name: result
method.description: Returns the same terminal result as [signal completed], or [code]null[/code] while observation is pending.

method.name: wait
method.description: Use [code]await operation.wait()[/code] to receive a [SteamSharedCloudFileResult] before or after observation ends.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted once after a pending download settles, including after cancellation or client shutdown. [method result] already returns this result during the signal.
